t: If those at your back send you as a forerunner to search out a rain-fed area for them, and you return to them and apprise them of greenery and water but they disagree with you and go towards dry and barren land, what would you do then ? He said : I would leave them and go towards greenery and water. Amir al-Mu'minin then said : So then extend your hand. This man related that : By Allah! By such a clear argument I could not refrain from swearing allegiance to Amir al-Mu'minin. This man was known as Kulayb al-Jarmi.
